title: 2032 — First commercial park hulls plant sells collector fields power t

description:
First commercial park hulls plant sells collector fields power to the grid under a 20-year tenant mix contract.

What must be true first: the collector fields results have to replicate outside the lab, park logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and storage operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed collector fields demonstrations, park logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting storage uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

t: Solar Thermal Industrial Parks Systems Simulator
title: Solar Thermal Industrial Parks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Solar Thermal Industrial Parks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Solar Thermal Industrial Parks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 49434 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where collector fields monitoring, park logistics redundancy, or storage maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Solar Thermal Industrial Parks Master Roadmap
title: Solar Thermal Industrial Parks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Solar Thermal Industrial Parks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Solar Thermal Industrial Parks — parks using solar for process heat.

Phase 1 — Prove (collector fields): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (park logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (storage): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (tenant mix): park hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and industry-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
